title: Recharge Bonus Event
subtitle: 1 $ = 3m coins
detailsText: The Recharge Rebate Event is now upgraded! No chest unlocking required — enjoy massive instant returns. Get 3 million coins for every $1 you recharge. Recharge now and claim big rewards instantly! 🎊
detailsNote: Note: Platform reserves the right to final interpretation of this event. Please consult customer service for specific rules.
tableText: For every $1 recharged, you will ultimately receive 3 million coins, including 1m basic coins and 2m event bonus coins. The same applies to all other recharge amounts; you can refer to the table below for details.
tableNote: Note: Details of the rewards for each recharge can be viewed in the coins Recharge Record.

faqs.q: How do I claim my bonus coins?
faqs.a: Bonus coins are automatically credited to your wallet instantly upon successful recharge. No manual claiming or chest unlocking is required!

faqs.q: Is there any limit to the recharge amount?
faqs.a: No! There are no limits to the recharge amount. You will receive 3 million coins for every single dollar recharged during the event duration.

faqs.q: Where can I view my recharge history?
faqs.a: You can view your detailed recharge and bonus records inside the 'Recharge Record' screen in your wallet settings.

rules: The event is active from July 18, 2026, until October 31, 2026.
Bonus coins do not count towards VIP level points; only basic coins contribute to VIP progress.
Any recharge done outside the event window will not be eligible for bonus rebate multipliers.
Hayi reserves the final interpretation rights of this event. In case of cheat detection, the system reserves the right to freeze the user account.
